## History

During his college years at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Blythe earned distinction among the Freshmen after leading them to victory in the annual Arts Rush. He later reconnected with [Anne](../character/anne.md), attending gatherings with friends and eventually proposing that they buy the larger [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to accommodate their growing family and practice. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) agreed, he locked up their beloved house of dreams alongside her as they departed for their new home in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Home P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), +114 more_
